name: placed-object-scale-messages
criteria: C1: `Constructor_InvalidScale_Throws` and `Update_InvalidScale_Throws` in `src/DungeonMaster.Tests/Domain/Entities/Floor/PlacedObjectTests.cs` each keep their five InlineData cases (NaN, PositiveInfinity, NegativeInfinity, 0.1f, 5.0f) and their existing ParamName assertion (`scale` and `newScale`), and each additionally asserts that the thrown exception's `Message` starts with `$"Scale must be between {ObjectScale.Min} and {ObjectScale.Max}."`, the expected text built from the `ObjectScale` constants as at `:107`, not a literal.

C2: Injected defect: inserting `if (float.IsNaN(scale)) { throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(paramName, scale, "injected"); }` as the first statement of `ValidateScale` in `src/DungeonMaster.Domain/Entities/Floors/PlacedObjectMethods.cs` leaves every PlacedObjectTests case green against the 3d496df test file, and after the change fails exactly the two NaN cases (one per theory) and nothing else in DungeonMaster.Tests; the injection is reverted and the file's sha256 equals its pre-injection sha256.

C3: Only `PlacedObjectTests.cs` differs from 3d496df at the end; it keeps no BOM, tab indentation, and all-CRLF line endings with no lone CR (Python `b.count(b'\r\n')`, `b.count(b'\n')`, `b.count(b'\r')` all equal; 160 each at 3d496df).

C4: `dotnet build src/DungeonMaster.sln` reports 0 Warning(s) and 0 Error(s), quoted from its summary lines, and `dotnet test src/DungeonMaster.sln --no-build` passes every test with each project's Total equal to the Total the same command printed before the change, both runs' full output saved to scratch before any filtering.

C5: On approval, the backlog row `2026-11-03 20261103-1654-test-strength Add message assertions for the NaN, infinity and below-Min arms` (`.sir/backlog.md:148` at 3d496df) is removed and no other backlog line changes.
